subject: Re: Kickoff: debiased calibration reporting - status + an uncomfortable finding
body:
Status: M1 done (Yusuf reproduced the intro reliability diagram, the ECE-distribution figure, and the TCE-controlled curves; pixel-level match after sorting out the cached data_dir). M2 is mid-flight - Katya has the debiased estimator API working with bootstrap CIs.

The uncomfortable finding: we ran the debiased estimator over 14 of our own recent model cards. For 9 of them, the debiased calibration error is 1.3-2.1x the ECE number we published - the bias the paper warns about was flattering us, especially on small eval sets where binning bias is worst. Two agent-confidence models move from "well-calibrated" to "borderline".

That makes M3 slightly political: when Evalline flips to debiased-by-default, historical comparisons will look like regressions. Recommend we ship with both numbers side by side for two quarters plus a one-pager explaining the estimator change, rather than silently replacing the metric.

Risk to M3 date: none currently - Tomas's review slot is booked for Apr 14.

Kaia
